# opnsense_auth_privilege (Data Source)

Looks up an OPNsense privilege by its ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Privilege ID.

### Read-Only

- `groups` (List of String) Group IDs assigned directly.
- `match` (String) API and GUI paths granted by the privilege.
- `name` (String) Privilege name.
- `users` (List of String) User IDs assigned directly.
